title: I Got Rhythm
text:
# Public domain: George Gershwin's "I Got Rhythm" (Girl Crazy, 1930) entered the US public
# domain on 1 January 2026 (and the EU's long before). These are the changes as jazz
# players commonly play them ("rhythm changes"), written out for this app — no scan.
title: I Got Rhythm
composer: George Gershwin (1930)
style: Medium Up Swing
time: 4/4
key: Bb
checked: 2026-10-04
form: A A B A

[A]
| Bbmaj7 G-7 | C-7 F7 | D-7 G-7 | C-7 F7 |
| F-7 Bb7 | Ebmaj7 Ab7 | 1. D-7 G-7 | 1. C-7 F7 | 2. C-7 F7 | 2. Bb6 |

[B]
| D7 | D7 | G7 | G7 |
| C7 | C7 | F7 | F7 |
